(Football school Jelgava) | nickname = | founded = {{Start date and age|df=yes|2017|4|4}} | ground = [[Zemgale Olympic Center]] | capacity = 1,560 | chairman = | manager = {{flagicon|LVA}} Valērijs Redjko | league = [[Latvian Higher League | Virslīga]] | season = [[2024 Latvian Higher League|2024]] | position = [[Latvian Higher League|Virslīga]], 10th of 10 | website = {{URL|https://www.fsjelgava.lv/}} | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = _nikepark7tr | pattern_ra1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = 780000 | body1 = 780000 | rightarm1 = 780000 | shorts1 = 780000 | socks1 = 780000 | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = _nikepark7w | pattern_ra2 = | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF }} '''FS Jelgava''', previous name '''Albatroz SC''', is a [[Latvia]]n [[Association football|football]] club that is based in [[Jelgava]]. Founded in 2017, it is the [[Phoenix club (sports)|phoenix club]] of [[FK Jelgava]], taking its place in the [[Latvian Higher League]] (Virslīga). In the [[2024 Latvian Higher League]] season, FS Jelgava ended up at the bottom of the table, but escaped relegation due to the denial of a Virslīga licence to [[Valmiera FC]] for the [[2025 Latvian Higher League|2025]] season.{{Cite web |date=2025-01-29 |title=Valmiera booted from top Latvian football league over financial affairs |url=https://eng.lsm.lv/article/culture/sport/29.01.2025-valmiera-booted-from-top-latvian-football-league-over-financial-affairs.a585687/ |access-date=2025-02-14 |website=[[eng.lsm.lv]]}}"}}
